prompt: Running 'java App' (no args) throws ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException. What is the fix?
choices: Declare args as String instead of String[]
explanation: args is never null but may be empty. args.length > 0 guards against the empty case. Fix: if (args.length > 0) System.out.println("Hello, " + args[0]); else System.out.println("No name given.");
